specification.name: Register Account
preconditions: User is not currently signed in.
requirements: REQ-AUTH-01: The system shall allow a new user to create an account with a unique email address.
REQ-AUTH-02: The system shall verify ownership of the email address before activating the account.
REQ-AUTH-03: The system shall enforce password strength rules during registration.

postcondition: User account is created, email ownership is verified, and the account is ready for login.

steps.text: User opens the registration form.
System prompts for name, email address, and password.
User enters registration information.
System validates the email address format and password strength.
System checks that the email address is not already registered.
System creates a pending account and sends an email verification link.
User opens the email verification link.
System activates the account.

postcondition: Invalid registration information is rejected and the account is not created.

steps.text: System identifies one or more invalid registration fields.
System displays validation messages beside the affected fields.
User corrects the registration information.
System detects that the email address already belongs to an account.
System offers the user the option to sign in or reset the password.
User chooses the next account access action.

specification.name: Setup Two-Factor Authentication
preconditions: User is authenticated or completing registration.
requirements: REQ-AUTH-04: The system shall support setup of an authenticator app as a second factor.
REQ-AUTH-05: The system shall provide backup recovery codes during two-factor setup.

postcondition: Two-factor authentication is enabled for the user's account.

steps.text: System displays two-factor authentication setup options.
User selects authenticator app setup.
System displays a QR code and manual setup key.
User scans the QR code with an authenticator app.
User enters the current verification code.
System validates the verification code.
System generates backup recovery codes.
User confirms that recovery codes have been saved.

postcondition: Two-factor authentication remains disabled until a valid code is entered.

steps.text: System rejects the verification code.
System asks the user to enter a new code from the authenticator app.

specification.name: Login
requirements: REQ-AUTH-06: The system shall authenticate registered users with email address and password.
REQ-AUTH-07: The system shall require a second factor when two-factor authentication is enabled.
REQ-AUTH-08: The system shall lock or throttle repeated failed login attempts.

postcondition: User is authenticated and the system opens the user dashboard.

steps.text: User opens the login form.
System prompts for email address and password.
User enters email address and password.
System validates the submitted credentials.
System determines that two-factor authentication is enabled.
System prompts for a two-factor verification code.
User enters the verification code.
System validates the verification code and starts an authenticated session.
System opens the user dashboard.

postcondition: User is authenticated without a second-factor challenge.

steps.text: System determines that the account does not require a second factor.
System starts an authenticated session.
System rejects the submitted credentials.
System displays a generic login failure message.
System increments the failed-login counter for the account or client.
System rejects the submitted verification code.
System prompts the user to try again or use a recovery code.

specification.name: Reset Password
preconditions: User can receive email at the account email address.
requirements: REQ-AUTH-09: The system shall allow a user to request a password reset link.
REQ-AUTH-10: Password reset links shall expire after a limited time.
REQ-AUTH-11: The system shall require the new password to satisfy password strength rules.

postcondition: User's password is changed and the old password can no longer be used.

steps.text: User selects forgot password from the login form.
System prompts for the account email address.
User enters the email address.
System sends a password reset link if the email address belongs to an account.
User opens the password reset link.
System prompts for a new password.
User enters and confirms the new password.
System validates the reset token and new password.
System updates the password and invalidates the reset token.
System rejects the reset token.
System asks the user to request a new password reset link.

scenarios.condition: New password does not meet policy
postcondition: Password remains unchanged until the user provides an acceptable password.

steps.text: System identifies password policy violations.
System displays password rules that must be satisfied.
User enters a revised password.
